docs.title: ADR-001: Every workspace route authorizes membership first
docs.heading: Decision
rules: Every API route under `/api/workspaces/[id]` MUST call `getWorkspaceMember(workspaceId, userId)` before it reads or writes any workspace data.
A missing membership MUST return 403, never 404 and never data.
docs.excerpt:
- Every API route under `/api/workspaces/[id]` MUST call `getWorkspaceMember(workspaceId, userId)` before it reads or writes any workspace data.
- A missing membership MUST return 403, never 404 and never data.
- Argument order is part of the contract. Changing it requires updating every caller in the same PR and a test for at least one route per subsystem.

docs.title: ADR-001: Every workspace route authorizes membership first

docs.excerpt: `getWorkspaceMember` is on the hot path of 17 route files. Treat any change to it as high risk.
